facts.text: I work on mathematical or logical problems during the day.
When I struggle to find a solution to mathematical or logical problems, I usually find a solution while falling asleep.
Sometimes I find a solution while waking up.
Most often, I get the solution before falling asleep.

keyphrases: difference between before falling asleep and falling asleep
